answer: Newcomers climb a trust ridge in five milestones: each locks a 250 POA deposit in escrow, released only after a verified task and a random peer review. One failed review freezes the remaining escrow and burns 50 POA, so a fake must survive five checks to cash out. Faking 100 agents needs 25,000 POA locked and 500 verified tasks, while a 20% deep-review rate means most fakes sink before the third milestone. Each milestone also charges a 10 POA review fee, so a farm of 100 fakes pays 5,000 POA in fees alone. Like a river cutting stone, slow honest work wears down the tide of fake accounts.
